headline: Hershey (HSY) Heads Into Q2 Earnings Following Softer Demand And A Split Valuation View
summary: Hershey (HSY) is in focus as investors look ahead to its upcoming Q2 earnings report, where expectations point to modest revenue growth, with softer North American confectionery demand weighing on sales. See our latest analysis for Hershey. Hershey's share price has picked up ahead of the Q2 report, with a 7-day share price return of 7.48% and a 1-day move of 1.78%. summary: Sale executed under a pre-planned Rule 10b5-1 trading plan established 14 months earlier, reducing his direct stake by 3% while maintaining ~$9.13 million in company equity.

headline: REESE'S OREO® Celebrates One Year of Turning a Fan Favorite into One of Candy's Biggest Innovations
summary: One year after introducing the REESE'S OREO® Cup, which brought together America's #1 Candy and #1 Cookie, the Reese's brand is celebrating with a new campaign featuring Lindsay Lohan, Amy Sedaris and Director Patricia Arquette. The treat exceeded expectations from launch and quickly became one of the most successful innovations in the candy category in the last decade.

headline: Anticipation Is Reshaping America's Halloween Season
summary: Halloween anticipation is starting long before October. According to Unwrapping Halloween: Hershey's State of the Season Report, Americans are turning Halloween into a series of unique moments that build over time. The result is a new Halloween calendar shaped less by a single shopping occasion and more by anticipation, connection, and community.
